Ava Kim: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem (2026-03-15) 1: we still see noisy pages from task-runner across regions. Putting owners + small action plan here so we can close the loop.

Ava Kim: TL;DR: dedupe pages by task_id+error_fingerprint+region, increase 'for' window to avoid 1s spikes, add short suppression for transient cache/db errors, wire telemetry to measure pages_per_fingerprint and inter-page gap.

Diego Ramos: Can you paste the exact alert today?

Ava Kim: Current rule (prod):
```yaml
alert: TaskRunnerFailures
expr: increase(sum(rate(task_errors[1m])) by (task), 5) > 8
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/pm-2026-03-15
```

Lina Zhou: Oof, `for: 30s` explains a lot. Single GC spikes will page. I'd set `for: 4m` and dedupe on `error_fingerprint`.

Marcus Chen: I'll own the alert PR to infra/alerts/taskrunner.yml. Plan: stage -> 72h canary in `canary-taskrunner` namespace -> gradual prod rollout. Target: PR open by Mon EOD.

oncall-bot: NOTE: alert PRs must include `rollback_plan` and `test_vector` per alerts policy.

Priya Rao: Important: do not dedupe across regions blindly. Use `task, error_fingerprint, region` as the grouping key so a regional outage still pages.

Diego Ramos: Also propose a suppression predicate: ignore pages when >=75% of recent errors are marked transient. Example: `suppress_if: increase(task_errors{transient="true"}[10m]) / increase(task_errors[10m]) >= 0.75`

Lina Zhou: I'll add telemetry PR to emit `pages_per_fingerprint` and `time_between_pages` so we can tune `paged_until` empirically. Doing that today.

Ava Kim: Action items (added to RDW-4421 and PM doc):
- Marcus Chen: PR for rule change (infra/alerts/taskrunner.yml) & rollout plan (target: Mon EOD)
- Lina Zhou: Telemetry metrics + Grafana panels for pages_per_fingerprint (target: Wed)
- Diego Ramos: Validation script and canary verify steps, aggregate paging counts after 24/72h (target: after canary)
- Priya Rao: Runbook edits: how to check, how to silence, escalation steps (target: Tue)

Marcus Chen: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812 (contains rollback: revert/rollback.sh, test vector in scripts/alert_smoke.sh). I'll include a `test_vector` that pushes synthetic labels to the pushgateway.

Diego Ramos: When you open the PR, include a small experiment to set `paged_until` annotation for the same fingerprint so repeat pages are silenced for N minutes. Start with 120m conservative. Also include exponential backoff for re-notify: `backoff: exponential(2m, 2, 5)`.

Ava Kim: Example snippet we discussed (to include in runbook/annotations):
```yaml
annotations:
  paged_until: 120m
  backoff: exponential(2m,2,5)
  note: "Do not dedupe across region label"
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-up owners have 7 days to update RDW-4421 with status or revise ETA.

Priya Rao: If the canary shows missed availability signals, we revert immediately. Also adding a safety SLO that pages with `severity=page` always surface in the primary ops channel for 10m before suppression applies.

Lina Zhou: I'll produce the first grafana panel and a small dashboard we can share in the PR.

Marcus Chen: PR opened and assigned reviewers. Will not merge until telemetry panels show expected reduction in duplicates in canary.

Diego Ramos: Thanks all. I'll post a 24h and 72h snapshot (counts + unique fingerprints) into RDW-4421.

Ava Kim: Great. Recheck here in 7 days. Ping @Ava Kim in this thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
